A separate explorer-health probe reports narrow selected-context facts; old workbench command returns a deprecation error naming explore and rejects legacy authoring/grant arguments.

decisions.authority_basis: Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required.
decisions.statement: Use authenticated same-origin JSON POST reads at /api/explorer/v1/context, /api/explorer/v1/search, /api/explorer/v1/entry, /api/explorer/v1/relationships, /api/explorer/v1/neighborhood and /api/explorer/v1/source; bootstrap/session exchange is separate. decisions.authority_basis: Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required.
decisions.statement: Add optional strict ontology-explorer.yaml presentation/limits configuration with neutral ONTOLOGY-depo starter/schema and explicit Template mapping. Missing configuration uses validated safe presentation defaults from the selected canonical project only; invalid or wrong-project configuration blocks reads. Category/start mappings refer to exact validated IDs, define display terminology only, and never become canonical knowledge or implicit hierarchy.

decisions.authority_basis: Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required.
decisions.statement: Materialize immutable canonical views with complete selected-input/module/source/helper/configuration/presentation digests and read-only observation of existing publication coordination. Before and after materialization, require stable version inputs and no active or unresolved selected-input publication transaction, including stable partial commits and lock missing-to-present races. Retry at most twice within the request deadline, then return knowledge_updating; do not create/acquire write-creating locks or invoke publication/recovery. An old coherent view may remain visible only with its original snapshot and clear update warning. Missing coordination proof fails closed, while stale source evidence alone does not erase safe recorded definitions. Cache a bounded current/retiring set and release retired views when readers finish.

decisions.authority_basis: Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required.
decisions.statement: Preserve canonical normalize/match/ranked semantics with semantic=False only for ordinary explorer search. Filter visibility/category/lifecycle before keyset pagination and project compact summaries. Use size-bounded, expiring HMAC cursors authenticated by a per-service-start secret and bound to service instance, reading session, resolved root/project, snapshot, normalized query/filter/direction/sort and last stable key. Validate scope against the active session on every page; cursors are not authentication or source/write authority and become invalid after service restart or a fresh reading session.

decisions.authority_basis: Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required.
decisions.statement: Use one normalized node/edge model for renderer and accessible relationship list. Initial one-step view evaluates about 25 nodes/50 edges; cumulative display ceiling evaluates 100 nodes/200 edges separately from tighter agent/API/byte/visited-node limits. Keep direction, every canonical relation ID and all qualifiers; unknown totals/hasMore stay unknown. The normalized data and List own no renderer dependency; renderer code consumes the same model and emits intentions through the shared read/state layer. A renderer import/layout failure leaves List, entry and source actions usable.

decisions.authority_basis: Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required.
decisions.statement: Use canonical stable-ID routes and browser history for deliberate navigation; bootstrap is consumed and removed before normal routing/copy. Selection, focus, query/filters, snapshot, expanded IDs, source selection and preferences remain separate. Preserve context on expiry/conflict/errors, reject late responses, lazy-load/dispose renderer resources, and keep source bodies in memory only. Implement the common API client, state transitions, snapshot conflict handling and encoded stable-ID hash routes before consumer screens. Prove pure transitions early; actual Back/Forward, focus and browser response-race integration is tested after all consumers exist.

decisions.authority_basis: Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required.
decisions.statement: Processes use supported canonical data and explicit exact source sections, with source attribution. Ordered text is shown only when ordering evidence is unambiguous; otherwise preserve the TRD exact missing-order sentence and documented relationships. No new schema field, invented process content or automatic flow library is needed to satisfy the first release.

decisions.authority_basis: Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required.
decisions.statement: Keep frontend source/build declarations in SKILLS-depo/ontology/explorer. Stage builds privately and publish a reviewed manifest and hashed runtime assets under explorer/assets, which the existing Template updater can ship without relaxing dist/build exclusions. Keep lock, BUILD.md, build identity and notices in the package; only manifest runtime members are HTTP-addressable. Source opens require selected record/reference identities and revalidated no-follow bounded bytes, never browser paths. Exact supported locator content or a clearly labeled bounded excerpt remains escaped and transient.

decisions.authority_basis: Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required.
decisions.statement: Keep implementation, generated Template delivery, inspected root adoption, active workbench retirement, any authorized provenance maintenance and rollback evidence separate. Complete reader/security/isolation acceptance on production assets before normal-entry cutover. Rollback restores approved code/assets/configuration only and preserves newer valid knowledge/history. The current initializer explicitly depends on legacy workbench assets; add an explicit current explorer capability/compatibility path and its completeness tests while preserving historical v9 receipt semantics. Neutral Template startup reports missing specialization honestly or is exercised through a documented disposable specialization, never a fabricated depot identity.

decisions.authority_basis: Plan proposal permitted by TRD D02/D03; exact plan approval and separately authorized implementation remain required.
decisions.statement: Treat all TRD D04/D05 layout, latency and fixture numbers as proposed initial evaluation targets. Use manual knowledge tasks and assistive technology checks in addition to automated tests; unavailable Windows/participants remain explicit limitations, and high-impact semantic misunderstandings block usability acceptance.

decisions.authority_basis: Qualified implementation-plan proposal preserving TRD D04; exact canonical plan review remains required.
decisions.statement: Evaluate TRD D04 starting values: 224-260 CSS-pixel collapsible rail, 65-75-character reading line, roughly 320-400-pixel map details panel, around 16 CSS-pixel body size, and approximately 44-pixel primary controls as comfort targets. The applicable AA target criterion remains 24 by 24 CSS pixels with exceptions. Tune search debounce near 150-200 ms initially, excluded from warm-search timing. These are subordinate to readability, accessibility and reflow and are not measured or approved layouts.
